title: GovernedLoop
description: A feedback/correction loop — the ONLY place a cycle is legitimate, and only when GOVERNED. Correction/convergence/homeostasis (vocab currency, self-heal, reasoner fixpoint, classifier retrain) win as loops, not DAGs. A loop is admissible only if it is BOUNDED (termination), CONVERGENT (a fixpoint or monotone measure), FAIL-CLOSED (refuse on non-convergence, never spin), ADMITTED by the superconscious (the global governor holds the convergence budget + refusal authority — loops don't self-authorize), and semantically grounded (what it corrects). 'A gate that cannot fail is not a gate' applied to iteration.

semanticRef.description: What this loop corrects (a drift-guard / DataClass / vocab node) — the grounding.

maxIterations.description: Termination bound — a loop that cannot terminate is not governed.

onNonConvergence.description: Fail-closed handler — never 'continue'. Refuse or escalate; a loop may not silently spin.

superconsciousRef.description: The superconscious governor that ADMITS this loop (refusal authority + convergence budget). Loops don't self-authorize.

placementRef.description: Field-calculus placement for the loop's work.
